known_issues.symptom: `repro-agent build` says the profile is not valid, but it looks fine
known_issues.cause: A field name was invented, or a `deny` policy value was loosened. The schema uses additionalProperties: false, so unknown keys are errors rather than being ignored.
known_issues.fix: Run `repro-agent validate .repro/project.json` — it names the exact path of the offending field.

known_issues.symptom: The generated task or HTML page still contains {{ROUTE_CHAIN}} or {{AUTONOMY_BLOCK}}
known_issues.cause: protocol/** was edited without regenerating the embedded copies.
known_issues.fix: Run `npm run generate` and commit src/core/protocol-data.ts and web/index.html.

known_issues.symptom: The offline HTML page shows an empty preview and does nothing when Generate is pressed
known_issues.cause: The page was saved by a tool that stripped or re-encoded the inline script, or the PROTOCOL block is empty.
known_issues.fix: Re-download the original file. Check that the browser console reports no syntax error in the inline script.

known_safe_checks: npx repro-agent validate <the file that is failing>
Confirm the file being validated starts with a "protocol" field
known_dangerous_actions: Do not edit src/core/protocol-data.ts or src/core/schema-data.ts by hand — they are generated and will be overwritten
Do not loosen a `deny` value in a policy block to work around a validation error
verification_steps: npm test  — all tests must pass
npx repro-agent task --name X --summary y | head -20  — must render without placeholders

extra_questions: Which AI assistant and model were you using?
Which of the four options (permission / network / effort / assistant) were selected?
